CREATE TABLE "bus_stops" (
  "stop_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each bus stop */,
  "stop_name" TEXT /* Name of the bus stop */,
  "latitude" REAL /* Latitude of the bus stop location */,
  "longitude" REAL /* Longitude of the bus stop location */,
  "address" TEXT /* Street address of the bus stop */,
  "city" TEXT /* City where the bus stop is located */,
  "state" TEXT /* State where the bus stop is located */,
  "zip_code" TEXT /* ZIP code of the bus stop */,
  "shelter" INTEGER /* Indicates if there is shelter at the stop (Yes/No) */,
  "current_service" INTEGER /* Current service status of the stop */,
  "installation_date" TEXT /* Date when the bus stop was installed */,
  "last_inspection_date" TEXT /* Date of the last inspection */,
  "last_maintenance_date" TEXT /* Date of the last maintenance */,
  "next_maintenance_due" TEXT /* Date when the next maintenance is due */,
  "ada_compliant" TEXT /* Indicates if the stop is ADA compliant */,
  "bicycle_rack" TEXT /* Indicates if there is a bicycle rack at the stop */,
  "real_time_info" TEXT /* Indicates if the stop has real-time information displays */,
  "surveillance_cameras" TEXT /* Indicates if the stop has surveillance cameras */,
  "service_status_id" INTEGER /* Foreign key to the service_status table */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("stop_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_bus_stops_shelter FOREIGN KEY ("shelter") REFERENCES shelter_types ("shelter_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_bus_stops_current_service FOREIGN KEY ("current_service") REFERENCES service_status ("status_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "service_status" (
  "status_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each service status */,
  "status_name" TEXT /* Name of the service status (e.g., Active, Inactive) */,
  "description" TEXT /* Detailed description of the service status */,
  "last_updated" TEXT /* Date and time when the status was last updated */,
  "updated_by" INTEGER /* User ID of the person who last updated the status */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("status_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "shelter_types" (
  "shelter_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each shelter */,
  "shelter_type" TEXT /* Name of the shelter type (e.g., Full, Partial) */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the shelter type */,
  "capacity" INTEGER /* Capacity of the shelter (number of people it can accommodate) */,
  "material" TEXT /* Material used for the shelter construction */,
  "last_inspected" TEXT /* Date when the shelter was last inspected */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("shelter_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "ridership_data" (
  "ridership_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each ridership record */,
  "stop_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the bus stop */,
  "year" INTEGER /* Year for which the ridership data is recorded */,
  "month" TEXT /* Month for which the ridership data is recorded */,
  "day_of_week" TEXT /* Day of the week for which the ridership data is recorded */,
  "hour_of_day" TEXT /* Hour of the day for which the ridership data is recorded */,
  "avg_on" INTEGER /* Average number of boardings for the year */,
  "avg_off" INTEGER /* Average number of alightings for the year */,
  "avg_total" INTEGER /* Total average of boardings and alightings for the year */,
  "peak_hours" TEXT /* Indicates if the data is for peak hours */,
  "low_ridership" TEXT /* Indicates if the stop has low ridership */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("ridership_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_ridership_data_stop_id FOREIGN KEY ("stop_id") REFERENCES bus_stops ("stop_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "user_name" TEXT /* Full name of the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., transit planner, data analyst) */,
  "phone_number" TEXT /* Phone number of the user */,
  "department" TEXT /* Department the user belongs to */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Date and time of the last login */,
  "last_logout" TEXT /* Date and time of the last logout */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "user_roles" (
  "role_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each role */,
  "role_name" TEXT /* Name of the role */,
  "permissions" TEXT /* Permissions associated with the role */,
  "created_on" TEXT /* Date and time when the role was created */,
  "modified_on" TEXT /* Date and time when the role was last modified */,
  "modified_by" INTEGER /* User ID of the person who last modified the role */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "access_logs" (
  "log_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access log */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user accessing the system */,
  "access_time" TEXT /* Time of access */,
  "action" TEXT /* Type of action performed (e.g., view, update) */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* IP address from which the access was made */,
  "user_agent" TEXT /* User agent string of the device used for access */,
  "session_id" TEXT /* Session ID of the user's session */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("log_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_access_logs_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "analytics_reports" (
  "report_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each report */,
  "report_name" TEXT /* Name of the report */,
  "generated_on" TEXT /* Date when the report was generated */,
  "data_summary" TEXT /* Summary of the data included in the report */,
  "generated_by" INTEGER /* User ID of the person who generated the report */,
  "report_type" TEXT /* Type of report (e.g., ridership, maintenance) */,
  "file_path" TEXT /* File path where the report is stored */,
  "file_size" INTEGER /* Size of the report file in bytes */,
  "is_archived" TEXT /* Indicates if the report is archived */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("report_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "stop_services" (
  "service_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each service record */,
  "stop_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the bus stop */,
  "service_description" TEXT /* Description of the services provided at this stop */,
  "service_type_id" INTEGER /* Foreign key to the service_types table */,
  "start_time" TEXT /* Start time of the service */,
  "end_time" TEXT /* End time of the service */,
  "frequency" TEXT /* Frequency of the service (e.g., every 15 minutes) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("service_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_stop_services_service_type_id FOREIGN KEY ("service_type_id") REFERENCES service_types ("service_type_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_stop_services_stop_id FOREIGN KEY ("stop_id") REFERENCES bus_stops ("stop_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "maintenance_logs" (
  "maintenance_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each maintenance record */,
  "stop_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the bus stop requiring maintenance */,
  "maintenance_date" TEXT /* Date of maintenance work performed */,
  "details" TEXT /* Details of the maintenance activity */,
  "technician_id" INTEGER /* Foreign key to the technicians table */,
  "cost" REAL /* Cost of the maintenance activity */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the maintenance (e.g., completed, in progress) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("maintenance_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_maintenance_logs_stop_id FOREIGN KEY ("stop_id") REFERENCES bus_stops ("stop_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_maintenance_logs_technician_id FOREIGN KEY ("technician_id") REFERENCES technicians ("technician_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "feedback" (
  "feedback_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each feedback entry */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user providing feedback */,
  "stop_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the bus stop related to the feedback */,
  "feedback_time" TEXT /* Time when the feedback was provided */,
  "comments" TEXT /* User's comments regarding the stop or service */,
  "rating" INTEGER /* Rating (1-5) provided by the user for the stop or service */,
  "is_resolved" TEXT /* Indicates if the feedback has been resolved */,
  "resolved_by" INTEGER /* User ID of the person who resolved the feedback */,
  "resolution_date" TEXT /* Date when the feedback was resolved */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("feedback_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_feedback_stop_id FOREIGN KEY ("stop_id") REFERENCES bus_stops ("stop_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_feedback_resolved_by FOREIGN KEY ("resolved_by") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_feedback_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "service_types" (
  "service_type_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each service type */,
  "service_type_name" TEXT /* Name of the service type (e.g., Regular, Express) */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the service type */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("service_type_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "technicians" (
  "technician_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each technician */,
  "technician_name" TEXT /* Name of the technician */,
  "specialization" TEXT /* Specialization of the technician (e.g., electrical, mechanical) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("technician_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "solvers" (
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each solver */,
  "solver_name" TEXT /* Name of the solver algorithm */,
  "factorization_method" TEXT /* Type of factorization method used by the solver */,
  "supports_indefinite" INTEGER /* Indicates if the solver supports indefinite matrices */,
  "out_of_core" INTEGER /* Indicates if the solver can operate out-of-core */,
  "parallelisation" TEXT /* Details on the parallelization method used */,
  "solver_description" TEXT /* Detailed description of the solver */,
  "default_version" TEXT /* Default version of the solver to be used */,
  "is_active" INTEGER /* Indicates if the solver is currently active and available for use */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "factorization_methods" (
  "factorization_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each factorization method */,
  "method_name" TEXT /* Name of the factorization method */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the factorization method */,
  "is_parallelizable" INTEGER /* Indicates if the factorization method can be parallelized */,
  "is_out_of_core" INTEGER /* Indicates if the factorization method supports out-of-core operations */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("factorization_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "solver_settings" (
  "setting_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each setting */,
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the solver this setting belongs to */,
  "setting_name" TEXT /* Name of the setting */,
  "setting_value" TEXT /* Value of the setting */,
  "is_required" INTEGER /* Indicates if the setting is mandatory for the solver to function */,
  "default_value" TEXT /* The default value for the setting */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("setting_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_solver_settings_solver_id FOREIGN KEY ("solver_id") REFERENCES solvers ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "performance_logs" (
  "log_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each performance log entry */,
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the solver for which this log is recorded */,
  "execution_time" REAL /* Time taken to execute the solver in seconds */,
  "memory_usage" REAL /* Memory usage during execution in MB */,
  "date_logged" TEXT /* Date when the performance was logged */,
  "solver_version" TEXT /* The version of the solver used during the performance log */,
  "input_size" INTEGER /* The size of the input matrix for the solver */,
  "error_rate" REAL /* The rate of errors or failures during the solver execution */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("log_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_performance_logs_solver_id FOREIGN KEY ("solver_id") REFERENCES solvers ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "username" TEXT /* Username of the user in the system */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., researcher, admin) */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* The date and time when the user account was created */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* The date and time of the user's last login */,
  "is_active" INTEGER /* Indicates if the user account is active */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_users_role FOREIGN KEY ("role") REFERENCES user_roles ("role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "access_logs" (
  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access event */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user accessing the solver */,
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* ID of the solver being accessed */,
  "access_date" TEXT /* Date when the solver was accessed */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* The IP address from which the user accessed the solver */,
  "user_agent" TEXT /* The user agent string of the device used to access the solver */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("access_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_access_logs_solver_id FOREIGN KEY ("solver_id") REFERENCES solvers ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "versions" (
  "version_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each version entry */,
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the solver associated with this version */,
  "version_number" TEXT /* Version number of the solver */,
  "release_date" TEXT /* Date of release for the version */,
  "change_log" TEXT /* Description of changes made in this version */,
  "is_stable" INTEGER /* Indicates if the version is considered stable */,
  "deprecation_date" TEXT /* The date when the version will be deprecated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("version_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_versions_solver_id FOREIGN KEY ("solver_id") REFERENCES solvers ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "user_roles" (
  "role_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each role */,
  "role_name" TEXT /* Name of the role */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the role */,
  "permissions" TEXT /* A JSON object or a comma-separated list of permissions associated with the role */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "solver_parameters" (
  "parameter_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each parameter */,
  "solver_id" INTEGER /* ID of the solver this parameter is associated with */,
  "parameter_name" TEXT /* Name of the parameter */,
  "parameter_value" TEXT /* Value of the parameter */,
  "is_required" INTEGER /* Indicates if the parameter is mandatory for the solver to function */,
  "default_value" TEXT /* The default value for the parameter */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("parameter_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_solver_parameters_solver_id FOREIGN KEY ("solver_id") REFERENCES solvers ("solver_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "event_bins" (
  "bin_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each event bin */,
  "bin_range" TEXT /* Range of values for the bin */,
  "total_samples" INTEGER /* Total number of samples in the bin */,
  "event_count" INTEGER /* Count of events recorded in the bin */,
  "non_event_count" INTEGER /* Count of non-events recorded in the bin */,
  "event_rate" REAL /* Event rate as a percentage */,
  "population_pct" REAL /* Percentage of the population represented by the bin */,
  "cumulative_event_pct" REAL /* Cumulative percentage of events up to this bin */,
  "cumulative_non_event_pct" REAL /* Cumulative percentage of non-events up to this bin */,
  "ks_statistic" REAL /* Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic for the bin */,
  "cap_rate" REAL /* Capture rate for the bin */,
  "cumulative_event_rate" REAL /* Cumulative event rate up to this bin */,
  "demographic_distribution" TEXT /* Demographic distribution of the population in the bin */,
  "geographic_location" TEXT /* Geographic location of the population in the bin */,
  "time_period" TEXT /* Time period for which the bin data is relevant */,
  "source" TEXT /* Source of the data */,
  "confidence_level" REAL /* Confidence level of the event rate */,
  "comments" TEXT /* Comments or notes about the bin */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("bin_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "event_statistics" (
  "statistic_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the statistic entry */,
  "bin_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the associated event bin */,
  "mean" REAL /* Mean of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "median" REAL /* Median of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "std_dev" REAL /* Standard deviation of event occurrences */,
  "variance" REAL /* Variance of event occurrences */,
  "min_value" REAL /* Minimum value of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "max_value" REAL /* Maximum value of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "quartiles" TEXT /* Quartiles of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "skewness" REAL /* Skewness of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "kurtosis" REAL /* Kurtosis of event occurrences in the bin */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the statistics were calculated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("statistic_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_event_statistics_bin_id FOREIGN KEY ("bin_id") REFERENCES event_bins ("bin_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "user_profiles" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the user */,
  "user_name" TEXT /* Full name of the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (admin, analyst, researcher) */,
  "department" TEXT /* Department the user belongs to */,
  "phone_number" TEXT /* Phone number of the user for contact */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Timestamp of the user's last login */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the user (active, inactive) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_user_profiles_role FOREIGN KEY ("role") REFERENCES roles ("role_name")
)

CREATE TABLE "event_access_logs" (
  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the access log entry */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user accessing the data */,
  "bin_id" INTEGER /* ID of the event bin being accessed */,
  "access_timestamp" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the access occurred */,
  "action_type" TEXT /* Type of action performed (view, download) */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* IP address from which the access was made */,
  "user_agent" TEXT /* User agent string for the access */,
  "location" TEXT /* Location from which the access was made */,
  "device_type" TEXT /* Type of device used for access (desktop, mobile) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("access_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_event_access_logs_bin_id FOREIGN KEY ("bin_id") REFERENCES event_bins ("bin_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_event_access_logs_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES user_profiles ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "admin_logs" (
  "log_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the log entry */,
  "admin_id" INTEGER /* ID of the administrator performing the action */,
  "action_description" TEXT /* Description of the administrative action */,
  "timestamp" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the action was recorded */,
  "action_type" TEXT /* Type of administrative action (create, update, delete) */,
  "affected_bin_id" INTEGER /* ID of the bin affected by the action */,
  "affected_user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user affected by the action */,
  "comments" TEXT /* Comments or notes about the action */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("log_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_admin_logs_admin_id FOREIGN KEY ("admin_id") REFERENCES user_profiles ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "event_reports" (
  "report_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the report */,
  "bin_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the associated event bin */,
  "report_content" TEXT /* Content of the report generated */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the report was created */,
  "report_type" TEXT /* Type of report (summary, detailed) */,
  "report_format" TEXT /* Format of the report (PDF, Excel) */,
  "created_by" INTEGER /* ID of the user who created the report */,
  "last_updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the report */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the report (draft, final) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("report_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_event_reports_created_by FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES user_profiles ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_event_reports_bin_id FOREIGN KEY ("bin_id") REFERENCES event_bins ("bin_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "data_imports" (
  "import_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the data import */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user who performed the import */,
  "import_timestamp" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the data was imported */,
  "file_description" TEXT /* Description of the imported file */,
  "file_type" TEXT /* Type of the imported file (CSV, Excel) */,
  "file_size" INTEGER /* Size of the imported file in bytes */,
  "import_status" TEXT /* Status of the import (success, failed) */,
  "import_notes" TEXT /* Notes or comments about the import */,
  "imported_bin_ids" TEXT /* IDs of the bins created or updated by the import */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("import_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_data_imports_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES user_profiles ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "roles" (
  "role_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the role */,
  "role_name" TEXT /* Name of the role */,
  "permissions" TEXT /* Description of permissions associated with the role */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the role was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the role */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the role (active, inactive) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "notifications" (
  "notification_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the notification */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user receiving the notification */,
  "notification_text" TEXT /* Text content of the notification */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the notification was created */,
  "is_read" INTEGER /* Flag indicating whether the notification has been read */,
  "notification_type" TEXT /* Type of notification (system, user) */,
  "priority" TEXT /* Priority of the notification (high, medium, low) */,
  "expires_at" TEXT /* Timestamp when the notification expires */,
  "sent_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the notification was sent */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_notifications_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES user_profiles ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loan_segments" (
  "segment_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each loan segment */,
  "credit_score_range" TEXT /* Range of credit scores for the segment (e.g., (664, 680]) */,
  "total_loans" INTEGER /* Total number of loans in the segment */,
  "percentage_of_loans" REAL /* Percentage of total loans in the segment */,
  "total_defaults" INTEGER /* Total number of defaults in the segment */,
  "percentage_of_defaults" REAL /* Percentage of loans that defaulted in the segment */,
  "segment_description" TEXT /* Description of the loan segment */,
  "created_date" TEXT /* Date the segment was created */,
  "updated_date" TEXT /* Date the segment was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("segment_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loans" (
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each loan */,
  "borrower_id" INTEGER /* ID of the borrower */,
  "loan_type_id" INTEGER /* Type of loan (e.g., personal, mortgage, auto) */,
  "loan_amount" REAL /* Amount of the loan */,
  "interest_rate" REAL /* Interest rate of the loan */,
  "credit_score" INTEGER /* Credit score of the borrower */,
  "segment_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan segment */,
  "loan_status" TEXT /* Status of the loan (e.g., active, defaulted, paid off) */,
  "origination_date" TEXT /* Date the loan was originated */,
  "maturity_date" TEXT /* Date the loan matures */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("loan_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loans_loan_type_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_type_id") REFERENCES loan_types ("loan_type_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loans_segment_id FOREIGN KEY ("segment_id") REFERENCES loan_segments ("segment_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loans_borrower_id FOREIGN KEY ("borrower_id") REFERENCES borrowers ("borrower_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "borrowers" (
  "borrower_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each borrower */,
  "name" TEXT /* Name of the borrower */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the borrower */,
  "address" TEXT /* Address of the borrower */,
  "phone_number" TEXT /* Phone number of the borrower */,
  "income" REAL /* Annual income of the borrower */,
  "employment_status" TEXT /* Employment status of the borrower (e.g., employed, self-employed, unemployed) */,
  "credit_history" TEXT /* Credit history of the borrower (e.g., good, bad, no credit) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("borrower_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loan_types" (
  "loan_type_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each loan type */,
  "loan_type" TEXT /* Name of the loan type (e.g., personal, mortgage, auto) */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the loan type */,
  "interest_rate_range" TEXT /* Range of interest rates for the loan type (e.g., 5-10%) */,
  "loan_term_range" TEXT /* Range of loan terms for the loan type (e.g., 1-5 years) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("loan_type_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loan_payments" (
  "payment_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each payment */,
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan */,
  "payment_date" TEXT /* Date of the payment */,
  "payment_amount" REAL /* Amount of the payment */,
  "payment_method" TEXT /* Method of payment (e.g., bank transfer, credit card) */,
  "payment_status" TEXT /* Status of the payment (e.g., pending, paid, failed) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("payment_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loan_payments_loan_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_id") REFERENCES loans ("loan_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "defaults" (
  "default_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each default */,
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan */,
  "default_date" TEXT /* Date of the default */,
  "default_reason" TEXT /* Reason for the default (e.g., job loss, medical emergency) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("default_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_defaults_loan_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_id") REFERENCES loans ("loan_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "credit_scores" (
  "credit_score_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each credit score */,
  "borrower_id" INTEGER /* ID of the borrower */,
  "credit_score" INTEGER /* Credit score of the borrower */,
  "credit_score_date" TEXT /* Date of the credit score */,
  "credit_reporting_agency" TEXT /* Credit reporting agency that provided the credit score (e.g., Experian, TransUnion) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("credit_score_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_credit_scores_borrower_id FOREIGN KEY ("borrower_id") REFERENCES borrowers ("borrower_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "risk_categories" (
  "risk_category_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each risk category */,
  "risk_category" TEXT /* Name of the risk category */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the risk category */,
  "risk_level" TEXT /* Level of risk (e.g., low, medium, high) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("risk_category_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loan_risk" (
  "loan_risk_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each loan risk assessment */,
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan */,
  "risk_category_id" INTEGER /* ID of the risk category */,
  "risk_score" REAL /* Risk score of the loan */,
  "risk_assessment_date" TEXT /* Date of the risk assessment */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("loan_risk_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loan_risk_risk_category_id FOREIGN KEY ("risk_category_id") REFERENCES risk_categories ("risk_category_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loan_risk_loan_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_id") REFERENCES loans ("loan_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "geographic_locations" (
  "location_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each location */,
  "city" TEXT /* City of the location */,
  "state" TEXT /* State of the location */,
  "country" TEXT /* Country of the location */,
  "zip_code" TEXT /* Zip code of the location */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("location_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "loan_originations" (
  "origination_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each loan origination */,
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan */,
  "origination_date" TEXT /* Date of the loan origination */,
  "location_id" INTEGER /* ID of the location where the loan was originated */,
  "origination_channel" TEXT /* Channel through which the loan was originated (e.g., online, branch) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("origination_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loan_originations_loan_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_id") REFERENCES loans ("loan_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_loan_originations_location_id FOREIGN KEY ("location_id") REFERENCES geographic_locations ("location_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "reporting" (
  "report_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each report */,
  "loan_id" INTEGER /* ID of the loan */,
  "report_date" TEXT /* Date of the report */,
  "report_type" TEXT /* Type of report (e.g., delinquency, default) */,
  "report_status" TEXT /* Status of the report (e.g., pending, submitted) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("report_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_reporting_loan_id FOREIGN KEY ("loan_id") REFERENCES loans ("loan_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "username" TEXT /* Username of the user */,
  "password" TEXT /* Password of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., admin, analyst) */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "phone_number" TEXT /* Phone number of the user */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "audits" (
  "audit_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each audit log */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user who performed the action */,
  "audit_date" TEXT /* Date of the audit */,
  "audit_action" TEXT /* Action that was performed (e.g., login, logout, update) */,
  "audit_description" TEXT /* Description of the audit */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("audit_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_audits_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "model_performance" (
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each model */,
  "accuracy" REAL /* The accuracy of the model */,
  "balanced_accuracy" REAL /* The balanced accuracy of the model */,
  "recall" REAL /* The recall of the model */,
  "precision" REAL /* The precision of the model */,
  "cohen_cappa" REAL /* Cohen's kappa score for the model */,
  "cappa_m" REAL /* Kappa-m score for the model */,
  "matthews_corrcoef" REAL /* Matthews correlation coefficient for the model */,
  "harmonic_mean" REAL /* Harmonic mean of the model's metrics */,
  "fbeta_score" REAL /* F-beta score of the model */,
  "auc" REAL /* Area under the ROC curve (AUC) for the model */,
  "f1_score" REAL /* F1 score of the model */,
  "gmean" REAL /* Geometric mean of the model's metrics */,
  "evaluation_script_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the evaluation script used */,
  "notes" TEXT /* Any additional notes or comments about the performance metrics */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the performance metrics were recorded */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the performance metrics */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("model_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_model_performance_evaluation_script_id FOREIGN KEY ("evaluation_script_id") REFERENCES evaluation_scripts ("script_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "models" (
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each model */,
  "model_name" TEXT /* Name of the machine learning model */,
  "algorithm" TEXT /* Algorithm used in the model */,
  "version" TEXT /* Version of the model */,
  "dataset_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the dataset used for training and evaluation */,
  "evaluation_date" TEXT /* Date when the model was evaluated */,
  "domain" TEXT /* The domain of the model (e.g., NLP, CV, Predictive Analytics) */,
  "status" TEXT /* Current status of the model (e.g., active, deprecated, in development) */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the model was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the model */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the model */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("model_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_models_algorithm FOREIGN KEY ("algorithm") REFERENCES algorithms ("algorithm_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_models_dataset_id FOREIGN KEY ("dataset_id") REFERENCES datasets ("dataset_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_models_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "datasets" (
  "dataset_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each dataset */,
  "dataset_name" TEXT /* Name of the dataset */,
  "source" TEXT /* Source of the dataset */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the dataset */,
  "domain" TEXT /* The domain of the dataset (e.g., NLP, CV, Predictive Analytics) */,
  "size" REAL /* Size of the dataset in MB */,
  "format" TEXT /* Format of the dataset (e.g., CSV, JSON, Parquet) */,
  "license" TEXT /* License under which the dataset is distributed */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the dataset was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the dataset */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the dataset */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("dataset_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_datasets_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "algorithms" (
  "algorithm_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each algorithm */,
  "algorithm_name" TEXT /* Name of the algorithm */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the algorithm */,
  "domain" TEXT /* The domain of the algorithm (e.g., NLP, CV, Predictive Analytics) */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the algorithm was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the algorithm */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the algorithm */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("algorithm_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_algorithms_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "versions" (
  "version_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each version */,
  "version_name" TEXT /* Name of the version */,
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the model this version belongs to */,
  "release_date" TEXT /* Date when the version was released */,
  "notes" TEXT /* Any additional notes or comments about the version */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the version was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the version */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the version */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("version_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_versions_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_versions_model_id FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES models ("model_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "user_name" TEXT /* Full name of the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., researcher, data scientist, admin) */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the user account was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the user account */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Timestamp of the user's last login */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "access_logs" (
  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access event */,
  "model_id" INTEGER /* ID of the model being accessed */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user accessing the model */,
  "access_date" TEXT /* Date when the model was accessed */,
  "access_type" TEXT /* Type of access (e.g., view, download) */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* IP address from which the access occurred */,
  "user_agent" TEXT /* User agent string of the client used for access */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the access event occurred */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("access_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_access_logs_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_access_logs_model_id FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES models ("model_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "projects" (
  "project_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each project */,
  "project_name" TEXT /* Name of the project */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the project */,
  "start_date" TEXT /* Start date of the project */,
  "end_date" TEXT /* End date of the project */,
  "status" TEXT /* Current status of the project (e.g., active, completed, on hold) */,
  "budget" REAL /* Budget allocated for the project */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the project was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the project */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the project */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("project_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_projects_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "project_models" (
  "project_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the project */,
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the model used in the project */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("project_id", "model_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "model_artifacts" (
  "artifact_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each model artifact */,
  "version_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the version this artifact belongs to */,
  "artifact_path" TEXT /* File path to the model artifact */,
  "artifact_size" REAL /* Size of the model artifact in MB */,
  "upload_date" TEXT /* Date the artifact was uploaded */,
  "notes" TEXT /* Any additional notes or comments about the artifact */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the artifact was uploaded */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the artifact */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who uploaded the artifact */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("artifact_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_model_artifacts_version_id FOREIGN KEY ("version_id") REFERENCES versions ("version_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_model_artifacts_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "evaluation_scripts" (
  "script_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each evaluation script */,
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the model this script is used for */,
  "script_path" TEXT /* File path to the evaluation script */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the script */,
  "notes" TEXT /* Any additional notes or comments about the script */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the script was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the script */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the script */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("script_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_evaluation_scripts_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_evaluation_scripts_model_id FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES models ("model_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "metric_definitions" (
  "metric_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each metric */,
  "metric_name" TEXT /* Name of the performance metric */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the performance metric */,
  "domain" TEXT /* The domain of the metric (e.g., NLP, CV, Predictive Analytics) */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the metric was defined */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the metric */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who defined the metric */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("metric_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_metric_definitions_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "metric_values" (
  "metric_value_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each metric value */,
  "model_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the model */,
  "metric_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the metric */,
  "value" REAL /* Value of the metric */,
  "notes" TEXT /* Any additional notes or comments about the metric value */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of when the metric value was recorded */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the metric value */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who recorded the metric value */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("metric_value_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_metric_values_model_id FOREIGN KEY ("model_id") REFERENCES models ("model_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_metric_values_metric_id FOREIGN KEY ("metric_id") REFERENCES metric_definitions ("metric_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_metric_values_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "samples" (

  "description" TEXT /* Description of the sample */,

  "tumor_type_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each tumor type */,

)

  "source_contact" TEXT /* Contact information for the source institution */,

)

)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,

  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access event */,

  "data_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each data point */,
  "ammo_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the ammunition type */,
  "distance" INTEGER /* Distance in yards */,
  "drop" REAL /* Drop in mils */,
  "wind_mph" REAL /* Wind speed in miles per hour */,
  "velocity" INTEGER /* Velocity in feet per second */,
  "energy" INTEGER /* Energy in foot-pounds */,
  "env_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the environmental condition under which the data was collected */,
  "atmospheric_pressure" REAL /* Atmospheric pressure in inches of mercury (inHg) */,

  "time_of_flight" REAL /* Time in seconds it takes for the bullet to travel the specified distance */,

  CONSTRAINT fk_ballistic_data_env_id FOREIGN KEY ("env_id") REFERENCES environments ("env_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_ballistic_data_ammo_id FOREIGN KEY ("ammo_id") REFERENCES ammo_types ("ammo_id")

CREATE TABLE "ammo_types" (

  "caliber" TEXT /* Caliber of the ammunition */,
  "grain" INTEGER /* Grain of the bullet */,
  "manufacturer" TEXT /* Manufacturer of the ammunition */,
  "bullet_type" TEXT /* Type of bullet (e.g., full metal jacket, hollow point) */,
  "powder_type" TEXT /* Type of powder used in the ammunition */,
  "primer_type" TEXT /* Type of primer used in the ammunition */,
  "case_material" TEXT /* Material of the cartridge case (e.g., brass, steel) */,

CREATE TABLE "environments" (
  "env_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each environmental condition */,
  "wind_speed" REAL /* Wind speed in miles per hour */,
  "temperature" INTEGER /* Temperature in degrees Fahrenheit */,
  "humidity" INTEGER /* Humidity in percentage */,
  "atmospheric_pressure" REAL /* Atmospheric pressure in inches of mercury (inHg) */,
  "wind_direction" TEXT /* Direction of the wind (e.g., north, south, east, west) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("env_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "user_name" TEXT /* Full name of the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., engineer, military, recreational shooter) */,
  "password_hash" TEXT /* Hashed password for secure user authentication */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Date and time of the user's last login */,

  CONSTRAINT fk_users_role FOREIGN KEY ("role") REFERENCES user_roles ("role_id")

CREATE TABLE "reports" (
  "report_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each report */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user who generated the report */,

  "env_id" INTEGER /* ID of the environmental condition used in the report */,

  CONSTRAINT fk_reports_env_id FOREIGN KEY ("env_id") REFERENCES environments ("env_id")
)

  "inventory_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each inventory item */,

  "last_updated" TEXT /* Date and time of the last inventory update */,

CREATE TABLE "suppliers" (

  "website" TEXT /* URL of the supplier's website */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("supplier_id")

CREATE TABLE "ammo_supplier" (
  "ammo_supplier_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each relationship */,
  "ammo_id" INTEGER /* ID of the ammunition type */,
  "supplier_id" INTEGER /* ID of the supplier */,
  "contract_expiration" TEXT /* Date when the contract with the supplier expires */,

  CONSTRAINT fk_ammo_supplier_supplier_id FOREIGN KEY ("supplier_id") REFERENCES suppliers ("supplier_id")

CREATE TABLE "user_access" (
  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access control entry */,

CREATE TABLE "ammo_inventory_history" (

  "change_quantity" INTEGER /* Quantity changed */,

CREATE TABLE "cities" (

  "last_updated" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last update to the historical population data */,

  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,

CREATE TABLE "calls" (
  "call_number" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each call */,
  "unit_id" TEXT /* Identifier for the responding unit */,
  "incident_number" INTEGER /* Unique incident number */,
  "call_type" TEXT /* Type of emergency call */,
  "call_date" TEXT /* Date the call was received */,
  "watch_date" TEXT /* Date the call was watched or logged */,
  "call_final_disposition" TEXT /* Final disposition of the call */,
  "available_datetime" TEXT /* Date and time the call became available for dispatch */,
  "address" TEXT /* Address where the incident occurred */,
  "city" TEXT /* City where the incident occurred */,
  "zipcode" INTEGER /* Zipcode of the incident location */,
  "battalion" TEXT /* Battalion responsible for the incident */,
  "station_area" INTEGER /* Station area responsible for the incident */,
  "box" INTEGER /* Box or sector of the incident location */,
  "original_priority" INTEGER /* Original priority assigned to the call */,
  "priority" INTEGER /* Priority assigned to the call after assessment */,
  "final_priority" INTEGER /* Final priority after incident resolution */,
  "als_unit" TEXT /* Indicates if ALS (Advanced Life Support) unit was required */,
  "call_type_group" INTEGER /* Grouping of call types */,
  "num_alarms" TEXT /* Number of alarms triggered for the incident */,
  "unit_type" INTEGER /* Type of unit responding to the call */,
  "unit_sequence_in_call_dispatch" INTEGER /* Sequence number of the unit in call dispatch */,
  "fire_prevention_district" INTEGER /* Fire prevention district of the incident location */,
  "supervisor_district" INTEGER /* Supervisor district of the incident location */,
  "neighborhood" TEXT /* Neighborhood where the incident occurred */,
  "location" TEXT /* Geographical location of the incident */,
  "row_id" INTEGER /* Unique row identifier for the call record */,
  "delay" REAL /* Delay in response time */,
  "caller_id" TEXT /* Unique identifier for the caller */,
  "call_source" TEXT /* Source of the call (e.g., 911, mobile app, web form) */,
  "call_duration" INTEGER /* Duration of the call in seconds */,
  "call_notes" TEXT /* Notes or additional details provided during the call */,
  "dispatcher_id" TEXT /* Unique identifier for the dispatcher who handled the call */,
  "is_anonymous" INTEGER /* Indicates if the caller is anonymous */,
  "language" TEXT /* Language used during the call */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("call_number"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_calls_call_type FOREIGN KEY ("call_type") REFERENCES call_types ("call_type_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_calls_unit_id FOREIGN KEY ("unit_id") REFERENCES units ("unit_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_calls_priority FOREIGN KEY ("priority") REFERENCES priorities ("priority_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_calls_incident_number FOREIGN KEY ("incident_number") REFERENCES incidents ("incident_number")
)

CREATE TABLE "units" (
  "unit_id" TEXT /* Unique identifier for each unit */,
  "unit_name" TEXT /* Name of the unit */,
  "type" TEXT /* Type of unit (e.g., TRUCK, ENGINE, MEDIC) */,
  "battalion" TEXT /* Battalion the unit belongs to */,
  "unit_status" TEXT /* Current status of the unit (e.g., available, en route, at scene) */,
  "unit_location" TEXT /* Current geographical location of the unit */,
  "unit_capacity" INTEGER /* Maximum capacity or number of personnel the unit can carry */,
  "unit_equipment" TEXT /* List of equipment available on the unit */,
  "last_maintenance_date" TEXT /* Date of the last maintenance check */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("unit_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_units_battalion FOREIGN KEY ("battalion") REFERENCES battalions ("battalion_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "incidents" (
  "incident_number" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each incident */,
  "incident_type" TEXT /* Type of incident */,
  "start_date" TEXT /* Date and time the incident started */,
  "end_date" TEXT /* Date and time the incident ended */,
  "final_disposition" TEXT /* Final disposition of the incident */,
  "incident_severity" TEXT /* Severity level of the incident (e.g., low, medium, high) */,
  "incident_cause" TEXT /* Cause of the incident (e.g., electrical fault, human error) */,
  "incident_outcome" TEXT /* Outcome of the incident (e.g., resolved, ongoing) */,
  "incident_notes" TEXT /* Additional notes or details about the incident */,
  "incident_media" TEXT /* Links to any media (e.g., photos, videos) related to the incident */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("incident_number")
)

CREATE TABLE "call_types" (
  "call_type_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each call type */,
  "call_type_name" TEXT /* Name of the call type */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the call type */,
  "is_emergency" INTEGER /* Indicates if the call type is for a true emergency */,
  "call_type_code" TEXT /* Code or abbreviation for the call type */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("call_type_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "priorities" (
  "priority_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each priority */,
  "priority_name" TEXT /* Name of the priority */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the priority level */,
  "priority_color" TEXT /* Color code for the priority level (e.g., red for high, yellow for medium) */,
  "priority_response_time" INTEGER /* Expected response time in minutes */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("priority_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "battalions" (
  "battalion_id" TEXT /* Unique identifier for each battalion */,
  "battalion_name" TEXT /* Name of the battalion */,
  "supervisor_district" INTEGER /* Supervisor district the battalion is responsible for */,
  "battalion_commander" TEXT /* Name of the battalion commander */,
  "battalion_location" TEXT /* Geographical location of the battalion headquarters */,
  "battalion_resources" TEXT /* List of resources available with the battalion */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("battalion_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "stations" (
  "station_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each station */,
  "station_name" TEXT /* Name of the station */,
  "battalion_id" TEXT /* Battalion the station belongs to */,
  "station_area" INTEGER /* Station area responsible for */,
  "station_commander" TEXT /* Name of the station commander */,
  "station_address" TEXT /* Full address of the station */,
  "station_equipment" TEXT /* List of equipment available at the station */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("station_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_stations_battalion_id FOREIGN KEY ("battalion_id") REFERENCES battalions ("battalion_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "neighborhoods" (
  "neighborhood_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each neighborhood */,
  "neighborhood_name" TEXT /* Name of the neighborhood */,
  "supervisor_district" INTEGER /* Supervisor district the neighborhood is in */,
  "neighborhood_population" INTEGER /* Population of the neighborhood */,
  "neighborhood_area" REAL /* Area of the neighborhood in square kilometers */,
  "neighborhood_risk_level" TEXT /* Risk level of the neighborhood (e.g., low, medium, high) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("neighborhood_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_neighborhoods_supervisor_district FOREIGN KEY ("supervisor_district") REFERENCES supervisor_districts ("district_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "fire_districts" (
  "district_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each district */,
  "district_name" TEXT /* Name of the fire prevention district */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the district */,
  "district_population" INTEGER /* Population of the fire district */,
  "district_area" REAL /* Area of the fire district in square kilometers */,
  "district_risk_level" TEXT /* Risk level of the fire district (e.g., low, medium, high) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("district_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "supervisor_districts" (
  "district_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each supervisor district */,
  "district_name" TEXT /* Name of the supervisor district */,
  "supervisor_name" TEXT /* Name of the supervisor responsible for the district */,
  "district_population" INTEGER /* Population of the supervisor district */,
  "district_area" REAL /* Area of the supervisor district in square kilometers */,
  "district_risk_level" TEXT /* Risk level of the supervisor district (e.g., low, medium, high) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("district_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "incident_responses" (
  "response_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each response */,
  "incident_number" INTEGER /* Reference to the incident */,
  "unit_id" TEXT /* Reference to the unit responding */,
  "response_time" TEXT /* Time taken to respond to the call */,
  "arrival_time" TEXT /* Time the unit arrived at the incident */,
  "departure_time" TEXT /* Time the unit departed from the incident */,
  "response_notes" TEXT /* Additional notes or details about the response */,
  "response_outcome" TEXT /* Outcome of the response (e.g., successful, failed) */,
  "response_media" TEXT /* Links to any media (e.g., photos, videos) related to the response */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("response_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_incident_responses_unit_id FOREIGN KEY ("unit_id") REFERENCES units ("unit_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_incident_responses_incident_number FOREIGN KEY ("incident_number") REFERENCES incidents ("incident_number")
)

CREATE TABLE "incident_resources" (
  "resource_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each resource */,
  "incident_number" INTEGER /* Reference to the incident */,
  "resource_type" TEXT /* Type of resource used */,
  "quantity" INTEGER /* Quantity of the resource used */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the resource */,
  "resource_cost" REAL /* Cost of the resource used */,
  "resource_supplier" TEXT /* Supplier of the resource */,
  "resource_serial_number" TEXT /* Serial number of the resource (if applicable) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("resource_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_incident_resources_incident_number FOREIGN KEY ("incident_number") REFERENCES incidents ("incident_number")
)

CREATE TABLE "performance_tests" (
  "test_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each test */,
  "test_name" TEXT /* Name of the test */,
  "description" TEXT /* Detailed description of the test */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test was last updated */,
  "test_type_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the type of test */,
  "system_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the storage system being tested */,
  "created_by" INTEGER /* Reference to the user who created the test */,
  "status" TEXT /* Current status of the test */,
  "start_time" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test started */,
  "end_time" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test ended */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("test_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_performance_tests_created_by FOREIGN KEY ("created_by") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_performance_tests_test_type_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_type_id") REFERENCES test_types ("type_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_performance_tests_system_id FOREIGN KEY ("system_id") REFERENCES storage_systems ("system_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_parameters" (
  "parameter_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each parameter set */,
  "test_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the test associated with these parameters */,
  "size" INTEGER /* Size of the data being processed */,
  "f" INTEGER /* Frequency parameter used in the test */,
  "threads" INTEGER /* Number of threads used in the test */,
  "data_type" TEXT /* Type of data being processed */,
  "io_type" TEXT /* Type of I/O operation */,
  "concurrency" INTEGER /* Number of concurrent operations */,
  "cache_size" INTEGER /* Size of the cache used during the test */,
  "compression" INTEGER /* Whether data compression is enabled */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("parameter_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_test_parameters_test_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_id") REFERENCES performance_tests ("test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_results" (
  "result_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each result entry */,
  "parameter_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the parameters for the test this result is associated with */,
  "duration" REAL /* Duration of the test execution */,
  "io_allocation" REAL /* I/O allocation during the test execution */,
  "read_speed" REAL /* Read speed during the test */,
  "write_speed" REAL /* Write speed during the test */,
  "error_count" INTEGER /* Number of errors encountered during the test */,
  "throughput" REAL /* Throughput of the system during the test */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("result_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_test_results_parameter_id FOREIGN KEY ("parameter_id") REFERENCES test_parameters ("parameter_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_logs" (
  "log_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each log entry */,
  "test_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the test associated with this log */,
  "message" TEXT /* Log message providing information about the test */,
  "logged_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the log was recorded */,
  "log_level" TEXT /* Severity level of the log */,
  "log_source" TEXT /* Source of the log */,
  "log_details" TEXT /* Detailed information about the log entry */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("log_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_test_logs_test_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_id") REFERENCES performance_tests ("test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "username" TEXT /* Username of the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., engineer, manager) */,
  "password_hash" TEXT /* Hashed password for user authentication */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Timestamp for the last login */,
  "is_active" INTEGER /* Whether the user account is active */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the user account was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the user account was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "user_access" (
  "access_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each access entry */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user accessing the test */,
  "test_id" INTEGER /* ID of the test being accessed */,
  "access_time" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test was accessed */,
  "access_type" TEXT /* Type of access */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* IP address from which the access was made */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("access_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_user_access_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_user_access_test_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_id") REFERENCES performance_tests ("test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_types" (
  "type_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each test type */,
  "type_name" TEXT /* Name of the test type */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the test type */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test type was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the test type was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("type_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "storage_systems" (
  "system_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each storage system */,
  "system_name" TEXT /* Name of the storage system */,
  "description" TEXT /* Description of the storage system */,
  "vendor" TEXT /* Vendor of the storage system */,
  "model" TEXT /* Model of the storage system */,
  "capacity" INTEGER /* Storage capacity in bytes */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the storage system was added */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the storage system was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("system_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "system_configs" (
  "config_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each configuration entry */,
  "system_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the storage system used */,
  "parameter_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the parameters used in the test */,
  "config_details" TEXT /* Details about the configuration */,
  "cache_policy" TEXT /* Cache policy used during the test */,
  "raid_level" TEXT /* RAID level configuration */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the configuration was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the configuration was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("config_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_system_configs_parameter_id FOREIGN KEY ("parameter_id") REFERENCES test_parameters ("parameter_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_system_configs_system_id FOREIGN KEY ("system_id") REFERENCES storage_systems ("system_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_results_summary" (
  "summary_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each results summary */,
  "test_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the test associated with this summary */,
  "average_duration" REAL /* Average duration of tests conducted */,
  "average_io_allocation" REAL /* Average I/O allocation during tests */,
  "total_tests" INTEGER /* Total number of tests conducted */,
  "success_rate" REAL /* Success rate of the tests */,
  "max_duration" REAL /* Maximum duration of the tests */,
  "min_duration" REAL /* Minimum duration of the tests */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the summary was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the summary was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("summary_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_test_results_summary_test_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_id") REFERENCES performance_tests ("test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "test_notifications" (
  "notification_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each notification */,
  "test_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the test associated with this notification */,
  "notification_type" TEXT /* Type of notification */,
  "message" TEXT /* Message content of the notification */,
  "sent_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the notification was sent */,
  "sent_to" TEXT /* Recipient of the notification */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the notification */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the notification was created */,
  "updated_at" TEXT /* Timestamp for when the notification was last updated */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_test_notifications_test_id FOREIGN KEY ("test_id") REFERENCES performance_tests ("test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "cryptocurrencies" (
  "id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each cryptocurrency */,
  "name" TEXT /* Name of the cryptocurrency */,
  "symbol" TEXT /* Unique symbol for the cryptocurrency (e.g., BTC, ETH) */,
  "price" REAL /* Current price of the cryptocurrency */,
  "volume_24h" REAL /* Trading volume in the last 24 hours */,
  "market_cap" REAL /* Market capitalization of the cryptocurrency */,
  "market_cap_dominance" REAL /* Market cap dominance percentage */,
  "fully_diluted_market_cap" REAL /* Fully diluted market cap */,

  "algorithm" TEXT /* Algorithm used by the cryptocurrency */,
  "block_time" REAL /* Average time to mine a new block */,
  "total_supply" REAL /* Total supply of the cryptocurrency */,
  "circulating_supply" REAL /* Circulating supply of the cryptocurrency */,
  "max_supply" REAL /* Maximum supply of the cryptocurrency */,
  "contract_address" TEXT /* Smart contract address (if applicable) */,
  "official_website" TEXT /* URL of the official website */,
  "whitepaper_url" TEXT /* URL of the whitepaper */,
  "description" TEXT /* A brief description of the cryptocurrency */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "historical_prices" (
  "price_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each price record */,
  "crypto_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the cryptocurrency id */,
  "timestamp" TEXT /* Timestamp of the recorded price */,
  "price" REAL /* Price of the cryptocurrency at the given timestamp */,
  "volume" REAL /* Volume of trading at the given timestamp */,
  "market_cap" REAL /* Market cap at the given timestamp */,
  "high" REAL /* Highest price in the given timeframe */,
  "low" REAL /* Lowest price in the given timeframe */,
  "open" REAL /* Opening price in the given timeframe */,
  "close" REAL /* Closing price in the given timeframe */,
  "change_24h" REAL /* Percentage change in the last 24 hours */,
  "change_7d" REAL /* Percentage change in the last 7 days */,
  "change_30d" REAL /* Percentage change in the last 30 days */,
  "source_exchange" TEXT /* The exchange from which the data was sourced */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("price_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_historical_prices_crypto_id FOREIGN KEY ("crypto_id") REFERENCES cryptocurrencies ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "trades" (
  "trade_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each trade */,
  "crypto_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the cryptocurrency being traded */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user who conducted the trade */,
  "trade_type" TEXT /* Type of trade (buy or sell) */,
  "quantity" REAL /* Quantity of cryptocurrency traded */,
  "price" REAL /* Price at which the trade was executed */,
  "trade_time" TEXT /* Timestamp when the trade occurred */,
  "order_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the order that initiated the trade */,
  "exchange" TEXT /* The exchange where the trade was executed */,
  "fees" REAL /* Fees associated with the trade */,
  "status" TEXT /* Status of the trade (e.g., completed, canceled) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("trade_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_trades_order_id FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES order_history ("order_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_trades_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_trades_crypto_id FOREIGN KEY ("crypto_id") REFERENCES cryptocurrencies ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "user_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each user */,
  "username" TEXT /* Username selected by the user */,
  "email" TEXT /* Email address of the user */,
  "password_hash" TEXT /* Hashed password of the user */,
  "role" TEXT /* Role of the user (e.g., trader, analyst, admin) */,
  "first_name" TEXT /* User's first name */,
  "last_name" TEXT /* User's last name */,
  "phone_number" TEXT /* User's phone number */,
  "address" TEXT /* User's address */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp when the user account was created */,
  "last_login" TEXT /* Timestamp of the user's last login */,
  "status" TEXT /* User account status (e.g., active, suspended) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "user_sessions" (
  "session_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each session */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user associated with the session */,
  "login_time" TEXT /* Timestamp when the user logged in */,
  "logout_time" TEXT /* Timestamp when the user logged out */,
  "ip_address" TEXT /* IP address used to access the platform */,
  "device_type" TEXT /* Type of device used (e.g., desktop, mobile) */,
  "device_id" TEXT /* Unique identifier for the device */,
  "session_duration" INTEGER /* Duration of the session in minutes */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("session_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_user_sessions_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "security_settings" (
  "setting_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for the security setting record */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user associated with the setting */,
  "two_factor_enabled" INTEGER /* Flag indicating if two-factor authentication is enabled */,
  "last_password_change" TEXT /* Date when the password was last changed */,
  "last_2fa_login" TEXT /* Timestamp of the last login with 2FA */,
  "last_ip_address" TEXT /* Last known IP address used to log in */,
  "session_timeout" INTEGER /* Session timeout duration in minutes */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("setting_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_security_settings_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "order_history" (
  "order_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each order */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user who placed the order */,
  "crypto_id" INTEGER /* Reference to the cryptocurrency being ordered */,
  "order_type" TEXT /* Type of order (buy, sell, or limit) */,
  "quantity" REAL /* Quantity of cryptocurrency in the order */,
  "price" REAL /* Price specified in the order */,
  "order_time" TEXT /* Timestamp when the order was placed */,
  "status" TEXT /* Current status of the order (e.g., completed, pending) */,
  "exchange" TEXT /* The exchange where the order was placed */,
  "fees" REAL /* Fees associated with the order */,
  "stop_price" REAL /* Stop price for stop orders */,
  "trigger_type" TEXT /* Type of trigger for stop orders (e.g., market, limit) */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_history_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_history_crypto_id FOREIGN KEY ("crypto_id") REFERENCES cryptocurrencies ("id")

CREATE TABLE "api_keys" (
  "api_key_id" INTEGER /* Unique identifier for each API key */,
  "user_id" INTEGER /* ID of the user associated with the API key */,
  "api_key" TEXT /* The generated API key string */,
  "created_at" TEXT /* Timestamp when the API key was created */,

  "description" TEXT /* Description or notes about the API key */,
  PRIMARY KEY ("api_key_id"), 
  CONSTRAINT fk_api_keys_user_id FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES users ("user_id")
